domains.arithmetic_model: bit-precise C arithmetic with mathematical comparisons evaluated in int32_t where specified

forbidden_transformations: removing static or inline qualifiers from production source
copying the production target body into a harness
reimplementing the target and proving only the reimplementation
replacing the target with a stub or uninterpreted function
using assertions whose antecedents are unreachable
disabling required overflow or undefined-behaviour checks
classifying timeout or resource exhaustion as PASS

result_classification.PASS: CBMC completes successfully and all theorem, safety, reachability and binding checks succeed.
result_classification.FAIL: CBMC produces a reachable counterexample to a registered property.
result_classification.INVALID: The proof is vacuous, misbound, transformed, stubbed, contract-replaced contrary to policy, or otherwise fails integrity controls.
result_classification.INCONCLUSIVE: The proof times out, exhausts resources, crashes, or cannot be completed under the frozen configuration.

claim_boundary.allowed: Repository-distinct, implementation-specific CBMC characterization at the pinned revision.
forbidden: canonical modular representatives were invented in this campaign
constant-time or side-channel security was proved by these functional properties
